shortDescription.default: A conversational, one-question-at-a-time form for SharePoint lists, on a page and in Microsoft 365 Copilot, with Yes/No, number, currency and hyperlink columns, a site and list picker in Copilot, a question editor, and a taller form.

longDescription.default: Guided Form is a conversational, one-question-at-a-time form for SharePoint lists. It shows one question at a time with smooth transitions, keyboard support (Enter to continue), a progress bar and a review step, then creates one item in a SharePoint list. It supports single line of text, multiple lines of text, choice (single or multiple selection), date-only and date-and-time columns (times are entered in the person's own time zone and saved as UTC), Yes/No, number, currency, and hyperlink (URL format only). Other columns are skipped, and a required unsupported column blocks the form with a clear message. In Copilot, if a list is missing the person can pick a site and list in the form; the tool result tells the model honestly if the form failed to open. Works as a SharePoint page web part and as a Microsoft 365 Copilot UX component where Copilot can prefill answers but never submits. Uses SharePoint REST as the signed-in user. No API permissions are requested.
